Household Demography model: sensitivity analysis

library(tidyr)

Multiparameter exploration of “householdDemography v.1.1 - kinship tabu for new couples”

Generate parameter values with Sobol Sampling

sobol_parameter_sample_dataFileName <- "data/sobol_parameter_values.RData"

# sobol_parameter_names <- c(
#   'initialNumHouseholds', 
#   'householdInitialAgeDistribution_min', 'householdInitialAgeDistribution_max',      
#   'maxCoupleCountDistribution_min', 'maxCoupleCountDistribution_max',
#   'acceptableKinshipDegreeForCouples', 
#   'cdmlt-level',
#   'c1-fert', 'mu-fert', 
#   'sigma1-fert', 'sigma2-fert',
#   'c1-women', 'mu-women', 
#   'sigma1-women', 'sigma2-women',
#   'c1-men', 'mu-men', 
#   'sigma1-men', 'sigma2-men'
# )
sobol_parameter_ranges <- list(
  initialNumHouseholds = c(2, 50),         
  householdInitialAgeDistribution_min = c(0, 5),        
  householdInitialAgeDistribution_max = c(6, 60),
  maxCoupleCountDistribution_min = c(1, 2),
  maxCoupleCountDistribution_max = c(3, 8),
  acceptableKinshipDegreeForCouples = c(0, 9),
  `cdmlt-level` = c(1, 25),
  `c1-fert` = c(0, 0.5),
  `mu-fert` = c(15, 30),
  `sigma1-fert` = c(1, 10),
  `sigma2-fert` = c(5, 20), 
  `c1-women` = c(0, 1),
  `mu-women` = c(15, 40),
  `sigma1-women` = c(1, 20),
  `sigma2-women` = c(1, 20), 
  `c1-men` = c(0, 1),
  `mu-men` = c(15, 40), 
  `sigma1-men` = c(1, 20), 
  `sigma2-men` = c(1, 20)
)
library(randtoolbox)
set.seed(123)
n <- 2000  # Number of samples
k <- length(sobol_parameter_ranges)  # Number of parameters

# Generate Sobol sequence
sobol_sample_matrix <- sobol(n, dim = k, scrambling = 3)

get_values_from_sobol <- function(param_index){
  return(qunif(sobol_sample_matrix[,param_index], 
                     min = sobol_parameter_ranges[[param_index]][1], 
                     max = sobol_parameter_ranges[[param_index]][2]))
}
# Transform to specific distributions
params_sobol <- data.frame(
  initialNumHouseholds = round(get_values_from_sobol(1)),
  householdInitialAgeDistribution_min = round(get_values_from_sobol(2)),
  householdInitialAgeDistribution_max = round(get_values_from_sobol(3)),
  maxCoupleCountDistribution_min = round(get_values_from_sobol(4)),
  maxCoupleCountDistribution_max = round(get_values_from_sobol(5)),
  acceptableKinshipDegreeForCouples = round(get_values_from_sobol(6)),
  `cdmlt-level` = round(get_values_from_sobol(7)),
      
  `c1-fert` = get_values_from_sobol(8),
  `mu-fert` = get_values_from_sobol(9),
  `sigma1-fert` = get_values_from_sobol(10),
  `sigma2-fert` = get_values_from_sobol(11),
      
  `c1-women` = get_values_from_sobol(12),
  `mu-women` = get_values_from_sobol(13),
  `sigma1-women` = get_values_from_sobol(14),
  `sigma2-women` = get_values_from_sobol(15),
  `c1-men` = get_values_from_sobol(16),
  `mu-men` = get_values_from_sobol(17),
  `sigma1-men` = get_values_from_sobol(18),
  `sigma2-men` = get_values_from_sobol(19)
)

head(params_sobol)
save(params_sobol, file = sobol_parameter_sample_dataFileName)
load(sobol_parameter_sample_dataFileName)

Visualising parameter space with pairs():

plotName = paste0(plotDirectory, "sobol_param_pairsPlot.png")

png(plotName,

Saving parameter configurations (experiments) in separate files:

```r
save_experiment <- function(experiment_dataframe, experiment_row, version_name) {
  write(paste(unlist(experiment_dataframe[experiment_row,], use.names = FALSE)), 
        file = paste0(dirname(getwd()), \experiments/\, version_name, \/\, experiment_row, \.txt\))
}

for (i in 1:nrow(params_sobol)) {
  save_experiment(params_sobol, i, \v1.1\)
}

endStates <- read.csv("simdata/v1.1/householdDemography v.1.1 - kinship tabu for new couples exp-endstates-table.csv", skip = 6)

Process parameters in list format in NetLogo:

extract_values_from_NetLogo_list <- function(char_vector) {
  # Remove brackets and split each string into two parts
  split_values <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", char_vector) |>
    strsplit(" ")

  # Convert to numeric vectors
  first_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) as.numeric(x[1]))
  second_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) as.numeric(x[2]))

  # Return as a named list
  list(
    first = first_values,
    second = second_values
  )
}

household_initial_age_distribution_range <- extract_values_from_NetLogo_list(endStates$householdInitialAgeDistribution)
max_couple_count_distribution_range <- extract_values_from_NetLogo_list(endStates$maxCoupleCountDistribution)

endStates <- cbind(
  endStates,
  household_initial_age_distribution_min = household_initial_age_distribution_range[[1]],
  household_initial_age_distribution_max = household_initial_age_distribution_range[[2]],
  max_couple_count_distribution_min = max_couple_count_distribution_range[[1]],
  max_couple_count_distribution_max = max_couple_count_distribution_range[[2]]
)

Categorise end states according to whether populations get extinct, survive and/or grow within the maximum number of simulation steps (max-iterations).

Visualise totalIndividuals:

hist(endStates$totalIndividuals, breaks = 50)

create new categorical variable:

max_population = 10000 # population size used in NetLogo as a stop condition when there is considerable growth  
endStates$survival <- ifelse(endStates$totalIndividuals > 0, "survival", "extinction")
endStates$survival <- paste(endStates$survival, ifelse(endStates$totalIndividuals > max_population, "with growth", ""))
table(endStates$survival)

         extinction             survival  survival with growth 
                4827                   76                 1097 
barplot(table(endStates$survival))

extract_age_structure <- function(char_value) {
  split_values <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", char_value) |>
    strsplit(" ")
  return(as.numeric(split_values[[1]]))
}

extract_age_structure_batch <- function(char_vector) {
  age_struct_df <- char_vector
  for (i in 1:nrow(char_vector)) {
    
  }
}

survival_cases <- endStates %>% filter(survival != "extinction ")

selected_case <- survival_cases[500, ]

selected_case_men <- extract_age_structure(selected_case["menAgeStructure"])
selected_case_women <- extract_age_structure(selected_case["womenAgeStructure"])

selected_case[1, "totalIndividuals"]
[1] 10135
layout(matrix(1:2, nrow = 1))
hist(selected_case_women, breaks = 101)
hist(selected_case_men, breaks = 101)

# Put data into long format
age_struct_df <- tibble(
  age = c(selected_case_men, selected_case_women),
  sex = c(rep("Male", length(selected_case_men)), 
          rep("Female", length(selected_case_women)))
)

# Bin ages into groups (5-year bins, adjust as needed)
age_struct_df <- age_struct_df |>
  mutate(age_group = cut(age, breaks = seq(0, 95, 5), right = FALSE))

# Summarize counts per age group and sex
age_struct_df_summary <- age_struct_df |>
  count(sex, age_group)

# For pyramid: make men negative
age_struct_df_summary <- age_struct_df_summary |>
  mutate(count = ifelse(sex == "Male", -n, n))
ggplot(age_struct_df_summary, aes(x = age_group, y = count, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
  labs(
    title = "Population Age Pyramid",
    x = "Age group",
    y = "Population count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Calculate the Peristera-Kostaki parameter ranges associated to survival:

compute_param_envelope <- function(param_df, low=0.025, high=0.975){
  apply(param_df, 2, quantile, probs = c(low, high), na.rm=TRUE) %>%
    t() %>% as.data.frame() #%>% rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`)
}
params_names <- gsub("-", ".", names(sobol_parameter_ranges)[7:19])
compute_param_envelope(endStates %>% filter(survival != "extinction") %>% select(params_names))

## Trajectories

>Run experiments in NetLogo Behaviour Space using average  parameter values for parametric demographic models within the configurations with surviving population in the former experiment.

Loading simulation experiments' end states:


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin eyJkYXRhIjoiYGBgclxudHJhamVjdG9yaWVzIDwtIHJlYWQuY3N2KFwic2ltZGF0YS92MS4xL2hvdXNlaG9sZERlbW9ncmFwaHkgdi4xLjEgLSBraW5zaGlwIHRhYnUgZm9yIG5ldyBjb3VwbGVzIGV4cC10cmFqZWN0b3JpZXMtdGFibGUuY3N2XCIsIHNraXAgPSA2KVxuYGBgIn0= -->

```r
trajectories <- read.csv("simdata/v1.1/householdDemography v.1.1 - kinship tabu for new couples exp-trajectories-table.csv", skip = 6)

Process parameters in list format in NetLogo:

extract_values_from_NetLogo_list <- function(char_vector) {
  # Remove brackets and split each string into two parts
  split_values <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", char_vector) |>
    strsplit(" ")

  # Convert to numeric vectors
  first_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) as.numeric(x[1]))
  second_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) as.numeric(x[2]))

  # Return as a named list
  list(
    first = first_values,
    second = second_values
  )
}

household_initial_age_distribution_range <- extract_values_from_NetLogo_list(trajectories$householdInitialAgeDistribution)
max_couple_count_distribution_range <- extract_values_from_NetLogo_list(trajectories$maxCoupleCountDistribution)

trajectories <- cbind(
  trajectories,
  household_initial_age_distribution_min = household_initial_age_distribution_range[[1]],
  household_initial_age_distribution_max = household_initial_age_distribution_range[[2]],
  max_couple_count_distribution_min = max_couple_count_distribution_range[[1]],
  max_couple_count_distribution_max = max_couple_count_distribution_range[[2]]
)
plot_name <- file.path(plotDirectory, paste0("HouseholdDemography-trajectories.", plot_file_format))

if (plot_file_format == "png") {
  graphic_scale <- 1
  # font_rescale <- axis_text_rescale <- margin_text_rescale <- 0

  png(plot_name, width = graphic_scale * 600, height = graphic_scale * 400)
} else if (plot_file_format == "eps") {
  graphic_scale = 1.2
  # font_rescale = -0.2
  # axis_text_rescale = -0.1
  # margin_text_rescale = -0.5

  extrafont::loadfonts(device = "postscript")
  grDevices::cairo_ps(filename = plot_name ,
                      pointsize = 12,
                      width = graphic_scale * 6,
                      height = graphic_scale * 4,
                      onefile = FALSE,
                      family = "sans"
                      )
}

ggplot(trajectories[trajectories$X.step. < 100,], aes(x = X.step., y = totalIndividuals, group = X.run.number., color = cdmlt.level)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("time (years)") +
  ylab("population (individuals)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title="Coale-Demeny\nLife Table Level")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 20 * graphic_scale),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10 * graphic_scale),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20 * graphic_scale),
        legend.key.size = unit(2 * graphic_scale, 'lines'))

dev.off()
